fundamental.summary: No insider or institutional signals detected; 26 days to earnings provides reasonable buffer but insufficient smart money conviction to establish position confidence.

sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market with mixed sentiment creates contrarian buy opportunity; no congressional signals to confirm or contradict setup.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX (27.66) and recent FOMC event (-2 days) create unfavourable conditions for swing trade entry in utilities; heightened volatility and post-event uncertainty warrant caution.
